skills.title: Kubernetes Pod CrashLoopBackOff Debugging
skills.description: Debugging techniques for Kubernetes pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff state.
guidelines: Check previous logs: kubectl logs <pod> --previous for error context
Examine pod events: kubectl describe pod <pod> for scheduling issues
Use ephemeral containers for debugging: kubectl debug <pod> -it
Test resource limits locally before deployment to ensure compatibility
Implement proper health check separation (liveness vs readiness probes)
Monitor restart count and memory usage proactively in production
Verify container image tags and runtime dependencies

skills.title: Istio Circuit Breaker Configuration
skills.description: Patterns for configuring circuit breakers in service mesh environments.
guidelines: Set connection pool limits per service destination to prevent overload
Configure outlier detection with failure thresholds based on service SLAs
Implement retry policies with exponential backoff to prevent cascading failures
Use priority-based routing during failures to maintain critical traffic
Configure request timeout hierarchies to respect upstream service constraints
Monitor circuit breaker state changes for proactive incident response
Test circuit breaker behavior with controlled failure injection

skills.title: Network Partitioning Recovery
skills.description: Strategies for handling network partitions in distributed systems.
guidelines: Implement quorum-based decision making to maintain data consistency
Use client-side service discovery for partition tolerance during DNS failures
Configure adaptive retry policies with jitter to distribute retry load
Monitor partition indicators across availability zones and regions
Implement partition-aware load balancing algorithms that detect outages
Test partition scenarios with chaos engineering to validate recovery procedures
Maintain fallback mechanisms for critical operations during partitions

skills.title: Autoscaling Threshold Optimization
skills.description: Best practices for configuring effective autoscaling thresholds.
guidelines: Set scale-out thresholds at 60-75% CPU utilization for responsive scaling
Configure scale-in thresholds at 25-40% CPU utilization for resource efficiency
Use asymmetric cooldown periods (faster scale-out, slower scale-in)
Implement warm pools for applications with long initialization times
Monitor provisioning time and success rates to refine scaling policies
Use predictive scaling for consistent workload patterns based on historical data
Configure health checks to ensure scaled nodes are ready before traffic routing

skills.title: Metric Cardinality Management
skills.description: Strategies for managing high-cardinality metrics in monitoring systems.
guidelines: Replace dynamic URL segments with placeholders (/users/{id}) in metrics
Group status codes into classes (2xx, 4xx, 5xx) to reduce cardinality
Implement cardinality limits at SDK level to catch issues early
Monitor time series count per metric to identify cardinality hotspots
Use aggregation to reduce dimensionality while preserving signal value
Set up cardinality budgets per team/service to enforce discipline
Regularly review and optimize high-cardinality metric patterns

skills.title: Terraform Race Condition Prevention
skills.description: Techniques for preventing race conditions in Terraform deployments.
guidelines: Implement remote state storage with proper locking mechanisms
Use S3 backends with DynamoDB locking for distributed coordination
Structure deployments as atomic units to minimize concurrent changes
Implement approval gates in CI/CD pipelines for critical infrastructure
Regularly backup state files and practice recovery procedures
Separate infrastructure by lifecycle and ownership to reduce conflicts
Use workspace isolation for development vs production environments

skills.title: DNS Load Balancing Troubleshooting
skills.description: Debugging techniques for DNS-based load balancing failures.
guidelines: Check service endpoints: kubectl get endpoints for connectivity verification
Verify DNS resolution from pods: nslookup for name resolution issues
Monitor DNS cache expiration times and TTL configurations
Implement health-aware client-side load balancing as failover
Use service mesh for real-time service discovery and health status
Test cross-namespace access permissions and network policies
Monitor DNS query latency and failure rates for performance issues
